parameters.query:
SELECT booking_id
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (b.offer_id) b.booking_id, b.booking_time
    FROM edoobox_raw.booking b
    JOIN kursplan.v_termin_erloes_produktiv t ON t.offer_id = b.offer_id
    WHERE b.is_deleted = false
      AND b.status = 'gebucht'
      AND t.date_start >= timestamp '2023-01-01'
    ORDER BY b.offer_id, b.booking_time DESC NULLS LAST
) x
ORDER BY booking_time DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 5;
